title.narrative: Output 1.1: A Global Toolkit that meets the requirements of fishers and their representatives is produced, refined and shared widely

description.narrative: The Global Toolkit (1.1) will provide information needed to enable fishers to download and operate the DASE application, which empowers them to participate in the surveillance of their coastal waters using a mobile phone. In focus countries, EJF experts will work with local partners to provide intensive inperson and remote training (1.2) to support the use of the application, improving the likelihood of it resulting in the identification of an IUU fishing vessel. EJF experts will then analyse photos from the application to produce evidence briefings to inform government action against IUU vessels to deter others.

description.narrative: The Global Toolkit (1.1) will provide information needed to enable fishers to download and operate the DASE application, which empowers them to participate in the surveillance of their coastal waters using a mobile phone. In focus countries, EJF experts will work with local partners to provide intensive inperson and remote training (1.2) to support the use of the application, improving the likelihood of it resulting in the identification of an IUU fishing vessel. EJF experts will then analyse photos from the application to produce evidence briefings to inform government action against IUU vessels to deter others.
